lessons.title: Practice DOM Event Fundamentals
lessons.description: The textContent property represents the text content of a DOM node. Implement createButton(text) as an arrow function that returns an object modelling a <button> element: { tag: 'button', textContent: text, disabled: false }. Export { createButton }. The test checks all three fields.
